source.title: Appointment of a New Senior Delegate - Africa (October 2018)
source.content:
As a result of our recent application period, a new Senior Delegate has been appointed. For the Africa region, the Board received the application of Philippe Virouleau and he has been appointed to the position.

The appointment is effective immediately. You may find his application [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dMz97ww0SUik5Etm1M8brRV-rXCIiqpu).

We want to thank Philippe for his willingness to help the WCA and the Speedcubing Community even more than he currently does now. Good luck to the new Senior Delegate in his role!

translation.title: 非洲高级代表任命公告（2018 年 10 月）
translation.content:
近期招募结束后，新一位高级代表已获任命。董事会收到了 Philippe Virouleau 对非洲高级代表岗位的申请，并已任命他担任此职。

任命即日起生效。他的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dMz97ww0SUik5Etm1M8brRV-rXCIiqpu)查看。

感谢 Philippe 愿意在已有工作之外，为 WCA 和速拧社区承担更多责任。祝新高级代表履新顺利！
